## Overview

A junior researcher assigned to Site Gamma-7 under the Flesh Architects. She kept a private journal documenting the facility's final days.

## Key Facts

- Worked at Gamma-7 during its decommissioning
- Last journal entry: the day the facility was shut down
- Was ordered to destroy all remaining samples but could not bring herself to do it
- Her journal confirms the Flesh Architects were a ViF division
- Her journal names the "Chief Architect" for the first time
- Noted the Covenant overrode access to Subject 242 (Zan) — subject escaped

## Current Status

Unknown. Her journal was hidden in the Burn Pit (Room 6) of Gamma-7, sealed in an oilcloth and tucked behind a loose stone in the furnace wall. Whether she survived the decommissioning or was transferred is unknown.

## Discovered By

The party finds her journal in Room 6 of Gamma-7 (Burn Pit / Waste Disposal) — DC 14 Investigation to find the loose stone.
